overview_text: The cybersecurity and political science combined major offers both a strong computer science foundation and a deep understanding of global and societal needs. Students practice the skills to become an engaged citizen of the world, participating in interdisciplinary scholarship and translational research to address regional and global issues, while also focusing on the conceptual and practical computer science skills to contribute to ensuring the reliability and security of cyberspace.
